claim_boundary: The variance ratio is a statistical diagnostic of multi-period return dependence, not a trading rule or evidence about Bitcoin. Exactly one future preregistered audit may test whether conditioning an otherwise identical positive 28-complete-day BTC trend policy on a four-day-to-one-day variance ratio above one adds matched-capital value versus both the unconditioned trend parent and passive BTC. The academic equity evidence supplies only the measurement prior; no equity result, causal claim or alpha claim is transferred to BTC.

primary_sources.identity: Lo and MacKinlay, Stock Market Prices Do Not Follow Random Walks, NBER Working Paper 2168
primary_sources.evidence: The paper tests the random-walk hypothesis by comparing variance estimators derived from returns sampled at different frequencies.
primary_sources.boundary: Its empirical sample is U.S. equities from 1962-1985, not Bitcoin, and rejection of a random walk does not by itself support a profitable directional rule.

primary_sources.identity: Lo and MacKinlay, The Size and Power of the Variance Ratio Test in Finite Samples, NBER Technical Working Paper 0066
primary_sources.evidence: The paper studies finite-sample behavior of the variance-ratio test under Gaussian and heteroscedastic random-walk nulls and several alternatives.
primary_sources.boundary: Finite-sample reliability is a warning to freeze the window and ratio definition before observing strategy economics; it is not BTC evidence.

adversarial_prior: A variance ratio above one is nondirectional; the positive-return condition may merely recreate a noisy shorter-horizon trend filter.
Serial dependence can be unstable across volatility regimes and can disappear after fees and adverse slippage.
A twenty-eight-day window contains few independent four-day increments and may concentrate apparent support in one bull year.
Daily-close aggregation discards intraday path information and can still remain fully exposed during fast drawdowns.
prohibited_rescue: Do not change the 28-day window, four-day ratio horizon, threshold one, positive direction, daily boundary or next-day execution after factor or outcome access.
Do not add alternate variance-ratio horizons, lag-one autocorrelation, volatility, volume, macro, on-chain or cross-asset inputs.
Do not invert to mean reversion, resize, short, leverage or waive matched-capital drawdown, Calmar, upside, breadth, concentration, holding, inventory or friction gates.

independence.distinct_from_closed_monthly_twelve_mont: The new state requires a preregistered multi-frequency variance relation over 28 complete days in addition to direction, rather than only the sign of a twelve-month return.
independence.distinct_from_closed_h1_lag1_autocorrela: The variance ratio aggregates covariance information over one through three daily lags and controls a standalone matched-capital BTC policy, rather than gating DRA entries with H1 lag-one correlation.
independence.residual_overlap_risk: The positive-return direction still overlaps the broad trend family, so independent incremental value and nonredundancy remain MISSING_PROOF.
